m_questTitle: Feel the Rhythm of the Night

m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: <ITALICS>You place the Wax Candles, the Singing Bowls, and the Traditional Crystal Stinger Staff on the Shrine. Now... </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You try to remember all the moves that Zam taught you. </ITALICS>
Let me pierce your skin! My saliva will reduce your ego! Soon, you'll be nothing more than a fleshbag of delicious juices!
I was saving the Mouse king for my nymphs when they hatch. Maybe I'll feed your pets to them instead. The babies are always so ravenous.
Yargh! Crushed and broken! Who will feed my babies now?
Who has come to save me? I cannot thank you enough, Spellbinder.
Bastion has been restored? Can it be true? Please, meet me there so I can see it with my own eyes.
I never believed I would see this day!
Go to the Round Dance Shrine on the edge of Celestial Lake, and place the items you've collected.
Then you'll have to do a Waggle Dance... You don't know the Waggle Dance?
Not... bad. Well, nothing says it has to be done well, at any rate. Just... do the best you can.
The entrance to the water cavern will rise. Head down and face Belosto ToeBiter. He's far more dangerous than his name suggests.
Once he's defeated, free the lost Mouse king!
Restore the Round Dance Shrine with the items you've collected. Then do the Waggle Dance... yes, well, do the best you can.
Head into the water cavern, battle Belosto ToeBiter, and rescue the lost Mouse king!
